description: List the standard website page set for a home-service trade: home, services hub, one page per core service with what it must cover, projects, service area, reviews, about, questions and contact, plus location pages for up to 20 cities. Comes with Google's written rules on doorway pages, people-first content, LocalBusiness structured data and business names, each cited. The service taxonomy is curated per trade and mapped to the trade's 2022 NAICS industry.

cities.description: Towns the business really serves, for location pages, such as ["Whitefish, MT", "Columbia Falls, MT"].

emergency_service.description: Whether the business takes emergency or after-hours calls. Defaults to what is typical for the trade.

maintenance_plans.description: Whether the business sells recurring service or maintenance plans. Defaults to what is typical for the trade.

trade.description: The trade: an id from list_trades (plumbing, hvac, electrical, roofing, landscaping, lawn_care, tree_service, pest_control and more) or a common name such as "plumber" or "AC repair".

name: trade_service_pages
title: Plan trade service pages
